rules.source: K.S. Krishnamurti, KP Readers (significator levels, cusp sub-lord theory)
rules.conditions: house significators in 4 levels: planets in the star of occupants; occupants; planets in the star of the cusp-sign owner; the owner

rules.source: K.S. Krishnamurti, KP Readers (significator levels, cusp sub-lord theory)
rules.conditions: the sub-lord of the primary E cusp signifies at least one favourable house and not more negating than favourable houses

rules.source: K.S. Krishnamurti, KP Readers (significator levels, cusp sub-lord theory)
rules.conditions: at least two of MD/AD/PD lords signify a favourable house and none signifies more negating than favourable houses

rules.source: K.S. Krishnamurti, KP Readers (significator levels, cusp sub-lord theory) (VERIFY)
rules.conditions: ruling planets at query time, optional, labelled horary; not used
